chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub, from Al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, that he said:

Any free woman who marries a slave and bears children from him, she has more right to her children than he does, and they are free. Then, when the man is emancipated, he has more right to his children than she does, because of the position of the father.

key_terms.أَحَقُّ: having the stronger legal claim or greater right
key_terms.اِمْرَأَةٍ حُرَّةٍ: a free woman, meaning a woman who is not enslaved
key_terms.لِمَوْضِعِ الْأَبِ: because of the legal standing and position of the father

ai.seo_question: Who has more right to child custody if a free woman marries a slave and he is later emancipated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning custody rights when a free woman marries a slave and bears children. It states that while the father remains a slave, the mother has greater right to the children, but once he is emancipated, the father has greater right due to his paternal position.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4503 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub, from Al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (as), who said:

"Any free woman who marries a slave and bears children from him, she has more right to her children than he does, and the children are free. However, if the man is emancipated, then he has more right to his children than she does because of his position as their father."
